title: Counterexamples to Whole-Sequence Convergence of Variable-Smoothing Full-Splitting Methods
summary: We study whole-sequence convergence of the smoothing-based full-splitting proximal subgradient method (S-FSPS) for structured nonconvex and nonsmooth fractional programs, introduced by Boţ, Li, and Tao (SIAM J. Optim., 35(4):2623--2653, 2025) as Algorithm~4.1. Existing theory guarantees only the existence of a subsequence converging to a limiting lifted stationary point.
